lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 106310110 · After Garden Room chat 2. Leona!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Flora!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Did a reporter visit the garden?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: He took photos of the garden and left ✿
Looks like you're doing a great job with the publicity.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Wow,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: that's amazing!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I have something I'd like to apologize to Flora about.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: To me?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: What for? ✿

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: We were handing out promo posters,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and someone who said he was a reporter

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: showed a lot of interest.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Anyway, he started taking photos and asking all sorts of questions,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: kinda like an interview!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I totally blanked out,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and before I knew it, I ended up saying the things you were supposed to say...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I told him about how Syuen is fully behind the garden being unveiled to the public,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and how she hopes that seeing the flowers, and how full of life they are,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: will inspire people.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I didn't even realize what I was saying.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It was my first time being interviewed like that.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: No wonder you've been such a nervous wreck lately.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I was worried I might have made a mistake.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Don't worry, you did nothing of the sort.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I must say that I didn't expect the reporter to head straight for the garden, though.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: You did well ✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I would've said the same thing myself.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: In fact, your doing that may have helped us avoid a crisis.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Did something happen?
Rian paid us a visit.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Why did she come today?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Wasn't she supposed to come tomorrow?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: but it seems she decided to stop by after seeing one of the promotional posters ✿

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Rian already caught wind of the posters? Well, that was fast!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Maybe we're better at publicity than we thought, meow.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Even Lobelia saw one.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Initially,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: she intended to shut down the garden and cancel the event,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: but thanks to that reporter's visit,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Salvia ended up giving an interview where she wished everyone a joyful time in the garden ✿
It turned out well.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Phew, what a relief!

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: And we owe it all to you, Sunflower ✿

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hehe :3

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Nice timing, meow.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Things really seem to be working out in our favor.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We should step up our publicity campaign even more.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I can't wait to see what you all come up with!
